// Probe for tests/unit/document-gate-storage-single-path.test.ts — GREEN. Agency
// assets and collaboration attachments live in other folders; they are not
// policy documents and the gate does not apply.
import { uploadFile, uploadFileDetailed } from "@/lib/storage"

export async function storeLogo(file: File) {
    return uploadFile(file, `agents/${"x"}/logo`)
}
export async function storeAttachment(file: File, folder: string) {
    return uploadFileDetailed(file, folder)
}
